cards.card_text: God goes on: the Israelites must not blaspheme God or curse the ruler of their people, and they're to give Him the firstborn of their sons, cattle and sheep.
cards.verse_text: You must not blaspheme God or curse the ruler of your people.
cards.snippet: You must not blaspheme God or curse the ruler of your people.

cards.card_text: He tells Moses to give the Israelites a law: anyone who curses his God shall bear the consequences of his sin, and whoever blasphemes the name of the LORD must surely be put to death, stoned by the whole assembly.
cards.verse_text: Whoever blasphemes the name of the LORD must surely be put to death; the whole assembly must surely stone him, whether he is a foreign resident or native; if he blasphemes the Name, he must be put to death.
cards.snippet: Whoever blasphemes the name of the LORD must surely be put to death; the…

cards.card_text: He blasphemes the LORD He hides from the LORD He forgets the LORD's commands
cards.verse_text: But the person who sins defiantly, whether a native or foreigner, blasphemes the LORD.
cards.snippet: But the person who sins defiantly, whether a native or foreigner, blasphemes the LORD.

cards.card_text: His sons blasphemed God and he did not restrain them He stopped offering the yearly sacrifices at the temple He let the lamp of God go out in the temple
cards.verse_text: I told him that I would judge his house forever for the iniquity of which he knows, because his sons blasphemed God and he did not restrain them.
cards.snippet: …house forever for the iniquity of which he knows, because his sons blasphemed God and he did not restrain them.

cards.card_text: Isaiah sends back the LORD's answer: don't be afraid of the words those Assyrian servants used to blaspheme Him.
cards.verse_text: So the servants of King Hezekiah went to Isaiah, who replied, “Tell your master that this is what the LORD says: ‘Do not be afraid of the words you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.
cards.snippet: …have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.

cards.card_text: Sennacherib has taunted and blasphemed and lifted his eyes in pride.
cards.verse_text: Whom have you taunted and blasphemed?
cards.snippet: Whom have you taunted and blasphemed?

cards.card_text: On top of that, He says His name is blasphemed continually all day long.
cards.verse_text: For My people have been taken without cause; those who rule them taunt, declares the LORD, and My name is blasphemed continually all day long.
cards.snippet: …those who rule them taunt, declares the LORD, and My name is blasphemed continually all day long.

cards.card_text: Then God tells Ezekiel to tell the house of Israel another way their fathers blasphemed Him, once He'd brought them into the land He swore to give them.
cards.verse_text: Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: In this way also your fathers blasphemed Me by their unfaithfulness against Me.
cards.snippet: …is what the Lord GOD says: In this way also your fathers blasphemed Me by their unfaithfulness against Me.

cards.verse_text: At this, the high priest tore his clothes and declared, “He has blasphemed!
cards.snippet: At this, the high priest tore his clothes and declared, “He has blasphemed!

cards.card_text: Jesus says whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit is guilty of eternal sin.
cards.verse_text: But whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; he is guilty of eternal sin.”
cards.snippet: But whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; he is guilty of…

cards.card_text: The city clerk says the men the crowd dragged in have blasphemed Artemis.
cards.verse_text: For you have brought these men here, though they have neither robbed our temple nor blasphemed our goddess.
cards.snippet: …brought these men here, though they have neither robbed our temple nor blasphemed our goddess.

cards.card_text: Paul quotes Scripture to the one who boasts in the law: God's name is blasphemed because of you.
cards.verse_text: As it is written: “God’s name is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you.”
cards.snippet: As it is written: “God’s name is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you.”

cards.card_text: Paul says he handed Hymenaeus and Alexander over to Satan so they would be taught not to blaspheme.
cards.verse_text: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan to be taught not to blaspheme.
cards.snippet: …whom I have handed over to Satan to be taught not to blaspheme.

cards.card_text: And James asks: aren't they the ones who blaspheme the noble name you've been called by?
cards.verse_text: Are they not the ones who blaspheme the noble name by which you have been called?
cards.snippet: Are they not the ones who blaspheme the noble name by which you have been called?

cards.card_text: Like creatures of instinct, the false teachers blaspheme.
cards.verse_text: They blaspheme in matters they do not understand, and like such creatures, they too will be destroyed.
cards.snippet: They blaspheme in matters they do not understand, and like such creatures, they too…
